parsed.rationale: All 15 participating records are unnamed extensions (name: "") on SwiftUI's `View` type spread across unrelated packages — WXUI, Wallpaper, PartyHorn, PlayerHeaderView, MusicShareKit, and app:iOS. The cluster signal is purely a name-collision on the implicit `View` extension target, not a structural duplication of members: every record carries an empty `fields_or_signature` list, so there is no shared method body or field set to consolidate. Extensions on `View` in SwiftUI are the idiomatic mechanism for adding view modifiers and are intentionally local to each feature package; collapsing them would couple unrelated UI concerns (e.g., `GlassEffect+Compatibility.swift`, `PlaybackBlendMode.swift`, `WipeDownRevealModifier.swift`) into a single location without any deduplication benefit.
